study: Ganzhi volatility incremental prediction, independent of direction EV
scope: Research only. No production code/API/calendar changes.
decision: Target day start (UTC+8 00:00). Train only source close strictly earlier; includes d-1 if valid. Forecasting-only, no exact-open fill assumption.
common_valid: Both OC and CC valid, excluding listing, source anomalies, invalid prior source, unclosed. All targets/models share this training/evaluation set; descriptive tables additionally retain own-validity counts.
exact_event_classification: Decimal source prices, no rounded float thresholds.

models.D: same Ganzhi expanding shrink20 toward global
models.D_raw: same Ganzhi raw, Beta(1,1) for events
models.D_2023: 2023+ same Ganzhi shrink20 toward 2023+ global; unavailable until >=30 recent global samples, earlier fallback D
models.E30: B30 plus regularized Ganzhi effect on honest historical B30 residuals
models.E: C plus regularized Ganzhi effect on honest historical C residuals
models.F: C-style state plus weekday; strict-vintage macro omitted where historical announced schedule not provable
models.G: F plus regularized Ganzhi residual effect
models.F_retro: state+weekday+actual CPI/NFP publication dates, conditional retrospective macro sensitivity, NOT full point-in-time predictive claim
models.G_retro: F_retro plus Ganzhi effect; same limitation

base_features: Past target lag1 and mean7,14,30,90; past range mean7,30 and past abs_oc mean7,30. Log features, 1e-6 floor. Event targets add past target rates7,30,90 with Beta(1,1) smoothing and logit transform.
continuous_fit: ridge log(y+1e-6), conditional mean via training-only smearing; no claim mean optimizes MAE.
binary_fit: ridge logistic Newton IRLS; intercept unpenalized; probability clip[1e-5,1-1e-5].
refit: monthly with available train labels; features update daily
base_validation: last252 eligible feature rows in3 forward blocks84; train labels closed strictly before first validation day start; min180 rows.
group_fit: Monthly using earlier genuinely OOS baseline residual forecasts; continuous shrunken group residual minus pooled residual. Binary group penalized offset logistic effect, frequency-centered; no fitted in-sample baseline residuals.
group_validation: 3 chronological validation blocks in last252 honest earlier predictions; fit offsets from labels closed before first validation day start; choose MSE/Brier; off wins ties.
group_alert_elevated: G continuous >F by20%, or probability G-F >=5 percentage points; only precomputed predictions form mask.
online_alert: Compare current forecast to90/80 percentile of its own last365-day previously issued forecasts; same retrospective fraction top10/20 also shown as ranking diagnostic.
primary_statistics: 3 continuous MSE/MAE plus8 binary Brier/LogLoss =22 endpoints x4pairs=88; same-day paired circular bootstrap block60,20000 replicates, Holm across88. Relative skill uses matched mean loss.
descriptive_permutation: Conditional omnibus across60 labels after controlling year, weekday and multiscale state. Independent circular rotations within each year preserve local clustering and year distribution. Global phase shift is invalid because60-day shift just relabels. 9999 main; within-year shuffled14/28-day blocks1999 sensitivity; 22 full/recent target hypotheses Holm.
group_uncertainty: Year-matched group-vs-overall differences; year cluster t using effective annual masses. 60x11x2windows=1320 Holm/BH tests; OOS group E-C/G-F loss differences separate1320-test family. Few years and serial dependence limit coverage.
robustness: Unmodified source primary. Training-only95/99percentile cap using past training; continuous99% cap and binary event unchanged. Independently rerun primary predictors excluding training years2020/2021/2022 one at time. Raw target scores unchanged. Descriptive delete-extreme-year and top1% diagnostics separate from tradable filters.
cutoff_design: Compare D vs D_2023 and group estimators A/B/C/D; evaluate whether2023 cutoff improves OOS intensity predictions, not prove2017 direction frequency forecasts.
development_recommendation: A stable independent value / B descriptive correlation only / C no proved independent predictive value. Determined from actual runs, no forced positive.
macro_limitation: Final publication dates lack pre-announcement vintage; retrospective flags only in explicitly labeled sensitivity, never substituted into strict primary F/G.
no_trading_pnl: Volatility forecasts have no direction; no synthetic trading profitability claim without executable option/derivative data.
pre_run_amendment: Before any forecasts/results: use day boundary instead of previous23:59 because this is a forecasting-only study with no execution-price claim; first lag is previous completed daily candle. Binary state lags refer to underlying magnitude plus separate smoothed event rates. Initial protocol retained.
